notes: Base unit ships with 8x NEMA 5-15R output receptacles split into 2 switchable/sheddable load banks of 4, one NEMA 5-15P input cord (8 ft), USB-B and RS-232 (DB9) ports with cables included, a programmable dry-contact relay interface, and an RPO/ROO (Remote Power Off/On) port. None of these control-signal ports (relay, RPO/ROO) have a dedicated connector id in the allowed list; they are almost certainly DB9-style connectors on the physical unit, so "rs232" was used as the closest match rather than a true grade-relevant RS-232 data link — treat these three as approximate/placeholder mappings. USB and RS-232 ports carry no bandwidth grade (correct per rules: analog/control ports are ungraded). The unit has an internal "mini-slot" communication bay (not a fixed port) that accepts optional cards: Network-M3 (Gigabit Ethernet/RJ45), INDGW-M2 (industrial gateway), or RELAY-MS (relay/serial). This slot is empty by default — no card ships with the base 9PX1500RT — so the RJ45 Ethernet port listed only exists if the optional Network-M3 card is purchased and installed; it is not a native port of the base SKU. Also not modeled: an EBM (external battery module) DC connector — this SKU accepts up to 4 daisy-chained 9PXEBM48RT battery packs via a dedicated battery-bus connector, but Eaton's spec sheet does not give an exact connector type/pinout for it, and it isn't a signal or standard power connector in the allowed list, so it was omitted. Power input plug is NEMA 5-15P (US, 120V, captive 8 ft cord) — no IEC inlet on this model. Source: official Eaton/Tripp Lite datasheet PDF (https://assets.tripplite.com/product-pdfs/en/9px1500rt.pdf) plus Eaton product page (https://www.eaton.com/us/en-us/skuPage.9PX1500RT.html), which corroborates output/input specs. Category/type mapped to "power"/"Power conditioner" as the closest fit for a UPS — no dedicated "UPS" type exists in the allowed list.

ports.name: Relay / Dry Contact

ports.name: RPO/ROO
ports.note: Remote Power Off / Remote On-Off port for emergency shutdown or remote restart; exact connector pinout not detailed in source, mapped to closest control-connector id
